subject: Private deployment: aligning atomic upgrade lanes, windows & rollback criteria
messages:
From: Sam Reynolds <sam.reynolds@acmepay.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.example>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example>
Cc: Sarah Milton <sarah@netops-consult.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private cluster upgrade window & safety asks

Hi Avery / Neha,

Thanks again for the pre-read. AcmePay is ready to schedule the next maintenance window for our private VPC deployment (cluster id: acme-nyc-03). A few requests up front so we can align internal ops: 

- We need a short, deterministic rollback path (not just "re-pin") that our network/security team can validate.
- Can you provide the exact preflight checks and timing assumptions for a 10% production canary vs. a 100% roll?
- Network ACL changes are required — we'll need a published IP list and the expected port/timeout changes.

Attached is our initial risk worksheet (upgrade-proposal-v1.pdf). Sarah from NetOps Consulting is on copy to help coordinate the ACL change schedule.

Proposed window: Thu 2025-07-24 01:00 - 05:00 UTC. If that doesn't work, suggest two alternatives.

Cheers,
Sam Reynolds
Sr. Platform Engineer, AcmePay

--
Attachment: upgrade-proposal-v1.pdf (7 KB)
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.example>
To: Sam Reynolds <sam.reynolds@acmepay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>, Sarah Milton <sarah@netops-consult.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 17:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private cluster upgrade window & safety asks

Sam — thanks for the clear asks and the worksheet. High level response and an ask from our side: 

1) Rollback model: we propose an "atomic-lane" rollback that combines a version anchor + staged KV-cache purge so the traffic surface can be restored to the previous binary without a full fleet redeploy. In practice that looks like:
   - Step A: Pin traffic routing to the previous shard (traffic anchor) via the Router QoS switch (30s goal).
   - Step B: Rehydrate previous model artifacts to warm caches on canaries (5–10 min).
   - Step C: Drain new-sequence KV entries and validate corpus checksums on canaries (3–7 min).
   - Step D: Flip the remaining nodes back to anchor if checks fail.

We'll document exact commands and timing in the upgrade-lane-matrix.xlsx.

2) Canary vs full roll timing: our standard timeline for a 10% canary -> 50% -> 100% sequence (with conservative validation gates) is ~75–120 minutes excluding preflight. If you accept a tighter gate we can compress to ~45–70 minutes. We'll include a shorter fast-fail path in the doc.

3) Network details: attaching netops-ip-rules.csv with the small IP ranges you need to allow. Sarah — can you confirm whether AcmePay needs the outbound webhook port opened (TLS 443) for the health probe during the canary?

Action items for today: 
- Sam: confirm proposed window 2025-07-24 01:00 - 05:00 UTC or give two alternates.
- Sarah: confirm ACL requirements and any maintenance blackout constraints.
- Neha/Karthik/Laura: I'll ask ops to prepare the preflight checklist and the rollback script for review by Wed EOD.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Principal Solutions, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: upgrade-lane-matrix.xlsx, netops-ip-rules.csv
From: Sarah Milton <sarah@netops-consult.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.example>, Sam Reynolds <sam.reynolds@acmepay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private cluster upgrade window & safety asks

Hi all — confirmed from AcmePay NetOps: outbound TLS 443 for health probes is fine. Two clarifications from our side: 

- We need a 15-minute notice before any BGP/ACL change so we can coordinate edge appliances.
- Any IP list changes must be staged in our staging ACL two business days prior to the window.

I reviewed the upgrade-lane-matrix and added a short column with the edge device steps (see attachment v1). A couple of operational constraints to call out: 
- If the canary reports any packet loss >0.5% or probe latency increase >200ms for two consecutive measurements, abort to rollback lane.
- NetOps will not accept more than one ACL delta during the window; bundle changes into a single commit.

Sam — please confirm the window and I'll schedule the ACL deployment.

Thanks,
Sarah Milton
NetOps Consulting

--

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>, Sarah Milton <sarah@netops-consult.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private cluster upgrade window & safety asks

All — quick confirmation and next steps from the Redwood side: 

- Window accepted: Thu 2025-07-24 01:00 - 05:00 UTC.
- Preflight doc (short checklist) and the rollback script are in the shared Drive folder (link below). Please review by Fri 2025-07-11 EOD so we can rehearse a dry-run the week of 2025-07-14.

Key operational notes (high level):
- Canary gating: CPU, latency P95, error-rate and KV-consistency check. Gate thresholds: CPU delta < 12%, latency P95 delta < 150ms, error-rate delta < 0.25%.
- Rollback triggers: any gate breach that persists for 3 consecutive measurement windows (2 min windows) or a manual abort from AcmePay on-call.
- Communication plan: we will run a single Slack channel (redwood-acme-upgrade) and a 30-minute post-mortem meeting within 2 hours of completion/failure.

Links: https://drive.redwood.example/drive/folders/1X-upgrade-checks | https://redwood.atlassian.example/PRIV-3245

I'll add the preflight checklist to the folder now. If no objections, we'll lock the date and start scheduling the dry run.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
